name: NBOH-2C-CN
summary: 25CN-NBOH, also known as NBOH-2C-CN or as N-(2-hydroxybenzyl)-4-cyano-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and 25-NB (NBOH) families. It was developed and described in 2011 at the University of Copenhagen.

pharmacology.text: The drug is one of the most selective agonists of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor known. A tritiated version of 25CN-NBOH has also been developed and used for more detailed investigations of the binding to serotonin 5-HT2 receptors and autoradiography.
pharmacology.kind: Selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: A tritiated version of 25CN-NBOH has also been developed and used for more detailed investigations of the binding to serotonin 5-HT2 receptors and autoradiography. In 2025, 25CN-NBOH was suggested as a possible alternative and replacement of DOI for use in scientific research.

summaryZh: 25CN-NBOH（或稱為NBOH-2C-CN，化學名：「4-{2-[(2-羥基苯基)氨基]乙基}-2,5-二甲氧基苯乙腈」，英語：4-{2-[amino]ethyl}-2,5-dimethoxybenzonitrile）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C18H20N2O3，是苯乙胺類化合物2C-CN的25-NB類衍生物，2004年在哥本哈根大學發現。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related N-benzyl drugs, the NBOMes, have caused seizures, a dangerously fast heart rate, very high body temperature and deaths. Its own effects in people have not been properly studied.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的 N-苄基類藥物 NBOMe 曾造成癲癇發作、危險的心跳過快、極高體溫以及死亡案例。它本身在人體的作用尚未有充分研究。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的 N-苄基类药物 NBOMe 曾造成癫痫发作、危险的心跳过快、极高体温以及死亡案例。它本身在人体的作用尚未有充分研究。

fact.en: 25CN-NBOH, made at the University of Copenhagen in 2011, is one of the most selective 5-HT2A receptor agonists known, and a radioactively labelled version is used to map that receptor in brain tissue.
fact.zh: 25CN-NBOH 於 2011 年在哥本哈根大學合成，是已知選擇性最高的 5-HT2A 受體促效劑之一，其放射性標記版本被用來標定腦組織中的這種受體。
fact.zhHans: 25CN-NBOH 于 2011 年在哥本哈根大学合成，是已知选择性最高的 5-HT2A 受体促效剂之一，其放射性标记版本被用来标定脑组织中的这种受体。
